subject: Kündigung Mitgliedschaft Finn

triage.summary: Parent Petra Langen cancels her son Finn's (U14) membership because the family is moving to Hamburg in October and asks what happens to the already paid annual fee — combines cancellation with a refund request, so it needs human attention.
triage.proposed_action: Route to a human board member: acknowledge the cancellation of Finn's U14 membership (relocation), confirm the exit, and have a human decide on and communicate the refund/pro-rata settlement of the already paid annual fee — no refund amount may be promised automatically.

details.refund_request: already paid annual membership fee, asks what happens to it

policy_reason: Policy: intent 'cancellation' requires human decision (mitten in der Saison — Trainerplanung und Erstattung)
